title: Sr. System Administrator
description:
**Senior Server Administrator – IT Infrastructure**
===================================================

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Senior Server Administrator is responsible for the design, administration, maintenance, security, and continuous improvement of the organisation’s server and IT infrastructure environment. The role will ensure that infrastructure services remain secure, resilient, highly available, and aligned with business requirements.

The successful candidate will provide senior-level technical expertise across physical and virtual server environments, operating systems, storage, backup, monitoring, patching, and infrastructure security. They will also play a key role in incident resolution, infrastructure projects, service improvements, and technical planning.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Server & Infrastructure Administration**

* Administer and maintain Windows and/or Linux server environments across physical and virtual platforms.
* Manage server hardware, operating systems, virtualisation platforms, storage, and associated infrastructure services.
* Monitor system performance, capacity, availability, and health, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
* Perform server builds, configuration, upgrades, migrations, and decommissioning in accordance with established standards.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, configuration records, and technical procedures.
* Ensure infrastructure platforms are appropriately configured for availability, performance, and resilience.

### **Infrastructure Operations & Support**

* Provide senior-level technical support for infrastructure incidents, service requests, and problems.
* Troubleshoot complex server, operating system, networking, storage, and infrastructure-related issues.
* Participate in an on-call or out-of-hours support rota where required.
* Lead or support the resolution of major incidents and provide root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Work closely with service desk, network, security, application, and other IT teams to resolve cross-functional issues.

### **Security & Compliance**

* Maintain server security in line with organisational policies and industry best practices.
* Manage operating system patching, vulnerability remediation, antivirus/endpoint protection, and security configuration.
* Support security audits, compliance requirements, and infrastructure risk assessments.
* Implement and maintain appropriate access controls, privileged access, and server hardening standards.
* Work with cybersecurity teams to investigate and remediate infrastructure security incidents.

### **Backup, Recovery & Business Continuity**

* Manage and monitor server backup and recovery solutions.
* Regularly test backup restoration and disaster recovery procedures.
* Support the development and maintenance of infrastructure disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Ensure critical infrastructure services meet agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives.

### **Projects & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead or contribute to infrastructure projects, including server upgrades, migrations, cloud adoption, virtualisation, and technology refresh programmes.
* Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to infrastructure services.
* Identify opportunities to automate routine administration and improve operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain technical standards, processes, and best-practice procedures.
* Support capacity planning and future infrastructure strategy.

### **Stakeholder & Supplier Management**

* Work collaboratively with internal IT teams, business stakeholders, and third-party suppliers.
* Provide technical guidance and communicate complex infrastructure issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support supplier management, technical reviews, and service improvement activities where required.
* Provide mentoring and technical guidance to junior infrastructure team members.

**Essential Skills & Experience**
---------------------------------

* Significant experience in a senior server/infrastructure administration role.
* Strong experience administering Windows Server and/or Linux environments.
* Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and core infrastructure services.
* Experience with virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Strong understanding of server hardware, storage, networking, and infrastructure architecture.
* Experience with enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Strong knowledge of server security, patch management, vulnerability remediation, and hardening.
* Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure incidents and performing root-cause analysis.
* Good understanding of ITIL principles and IT service management processes.
* Experience working with monitoring and infrastructure management tools.
* Strong documentation and technical communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical issues.

**Desirable Skills**
--------------------

* Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or other cloud infrastructure platforms.
* Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting/automation technologies.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience with enterprise storage technologies.
* Experience with high-availability and disaster recovery architectures.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, VMware, Linux, ITIL, or cloud certifications.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* **Technical expertise:** Demonstrates strong knowledge of server and infrastructure technologies.
* **Problem solving:** Able to diagnose complex technical problems and develop effective solutions.
* **Ownership:** Takes responsibility for infrastructure services and follows issues through to resolution.
* **Communication:** Communicates clearly with technical teams, management, suppliers, and business stakeholders.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identifies opportunities to improve reliability, security, performance, and efficiency.
* **Teamwork:** Works effectively across IT teams and supports knowledge sharing.
* **Resilience:** Able to manage priorities and remain effective during incidents and high-pressure situations.

**Key Performance Indicators**
------------------------------

* Infrastructure availability and reliability.
* Timely resolution of infrastructure incidents and problems.
* Successful completion of infrastructure projects and upgrades.
* Server patching and vulnerability remediation compliance.
* Backup success rates and successful recovery testing.
* Infrastructure security and compliance performance.
* Reduction in recurring incidents and infrastructure-related risks.
* Quality and accuracy of infrastructure documentation.
* Delivery of automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Senior Server Administrator will be a key member of the IT Infrastructure team, responsible for ensuring the stability, security, resilience, and performance of critical server and infrastructure services. The role requires a proactive and technically capable individual who can manage day-to-day operations while also contributing to strategic infrastructure improvements and business continuity.

Technical Support Engineer plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of technical systems, providing expert-level support to customers, and contributing to the improvement of products and services through technical expertise and leadership.

**To meet the qualifications specified:**

1. Educational Background: A degree in a relevant field, such as Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, is a requirement.  
2. Experience: While not explicitly mandatory, experience in fields like Computer Science or IT is considered advantageous. It may provide a practical understanding of the domain that can be beneficial in this role.  
3. Personal Traits: Being a natural helper and enjoying assisting people with their computer issues are essential qualities. Additionally, the ability to simplify and effectively communicate technical details to individuals with varying levels of technical knowledge is a significant advantage.

If you possess the educational qualifications, experience, and the mentioned traits, it's likely you fit the criteria for this role. Demonstrating your passion for helping people with technical issues and your ability to communicate complex information in an understandable manner during the application.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Technical Expertise:**  
Provide advanced technical support to customers and internal teams. Troubleshoot complex technical issues related to software, hardware, or network systems. Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement permanent resolutions. Collaborate with development teams to escalate and resolve product issues. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of new technologies and industry trends.

**Customer Support:**  
Act as a point of escalation for critical customer issues. Communicate effectively with customers to understand their technical concerns. Manage and prioritize support tickets and customer inquiries. Ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to service level agreements (SLAs). Provide training and guidance to junior support engineers.

**Documentation and Reporting:**  
Document troubleshooting steps and solutions for knowledge base articles. Create and maintain technical documentation, including FAQs and user guides. Generate regular reports on support activities, issue trends, and resolution metrics.

**Quality Assurance:**  
Conduct quality assurance testing for new software releases or patches. Validate bug fixes and ensure they meet customer requirements. Perform regression testing to identify potential issues before deployment.

**Communication Skills:**  
Communicate technical information effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Provide regular updates to customers and stakeholders on issue status and resolution. Participate in customer-facing meetings and conference calls as a technical expert.

**Troubleshooting and Problem-Solving:**  
Utilize diagnostic tools and resources to analyze technical issues. Develop creative solutions to complex technical problems. Implement temporary workarounds and permanent fixes as necessary.

**Compliance and Security:**  
Ensure compliance with data protection regulations and security best practices. Follow established protocols for handling sensitive customer information.

**Required Skill Set:**  
MS Office, Windows Troubleshooting, ITIL, Basic Networking, Understanding of EDR, DLP Tools, Firewalls, VMware/ Citrix workspace Client setup troubleshooting, Active Directory, Basic Concepts of O365 Exchange admin, Microsoft MDM & Intune, Firewalls, DLP, EDR, Proxy concepts, Fundamental understanding of ITSM, ITIL, or CMDB.
